reason_and_constraint: Duplicate-safe retries are a requirement; the reference engine posts twice or throws on a double click.

proposed_difference: Open Messages asks for changes every 15 s (30 s elsewhere) and when the tab becomes visible, instead of push.
reason_and_constraint: No realtime service in the stack (C-09).

proposed_difference: Directory and library lists load whole in the browser; Consult list holds the latest 200 discussions.

proposed_difference: The sandbox directory holds the 18 reference colleagues plus 1,200 fictional colleagues across six Northeast states (1,212 in all), so Network/Search and matching behave as they would at real size. The landing page says so.

proposed_difference: The Messages footer reads "Sandbox · Delivery is simulated" in the sandbox, "Private, in-network messaging" on the live site, and the approved "Browser-local preview · Delivery is simulated" in the tours.

target_evidence: SBX-07, SBX-09, SBX-14, SBX-15; job pa_demo_autorespond

proposed_difference: The sandbox Consult screen lists 40 discussions: the 9 from the reference story and a shared base of fictional ones addressed to audiences the visitor belongs to. Discussions addressed to audiences the visitor is not in are never shown.
